chunks: And it is narrated from Kāmil, who said:
I was with Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام at al-ʿUrayḍ when a severe wind blew. Then Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام began saying takbīr, then he said: “Indeed, the takbīr repels the wind.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَ: the utterance of magnifying Allah, saying 'Allāhu Akbar'
key_terms.بِالْعُرَيْضِ: at al-ʿUrayḍ, the location mentioned in the report
key_terms.يُكَبِّرُ: he was saying takbīr, repeating 'Allāhu Akbar'

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام respond to a strong wind?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام responded to a strong wind by repeatedly saying takbīr. It presents takbīr as a form of dhikr through which harm such as violent wind is repelled.
